# anypoint_private_space_upgrade (Data Source)

Reads the `upgrade status` of a private space.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anypoint_private_space_upgrade" "upgrade" {
  org_id           = var.root_org
  private_space_id = var.private_space_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) The organization id where the private space is defined.
- `private_space_id` (String) The unique identifier of the private space.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) This resource's unique id, equal to the private space id.
- `scheduled_update_time` (String) The date the upgrade is scheduled for.
- `status` (String) The upgrade status (e.g. QUEUED).
